comparison.objective: Bleed air from a brake caliper using correctly ordered pedal and bleeder cycles.
comparison.physical_skill: Coordinate cyclic pedal actuation and wrench control so the bleeder closes before pedal return.
comparison.success_condition: Air reduced to threshold without any backflow event; bleeder shut, pedal returned, tools released.
comparison.reason: This tests timed fluid-service sequencing and valve control, not physical size separation or loaded-container manipulation.
